name: matching: Which of the following is accurate with respect to…

request.questionText: Which of the following is accurate with respect to randomization in experimental design? Select TRUE or FALSE for each statement below.

blanks.label: Randomization works, essentially, by flipping a coin independently for each subject in a study: heads, you get the treatment; tails, you get the control.
Randomization ensures that the sample of participants included in the experiment are representative of the larger population of interest.
The fundamental source of uncertainty in an experiment arises from the random assignment of experimental units to treatment or control.
We use randomization to identify nuisance factors that could affect the outcome of the experiment.
Randomization ensures balance, on average, even for possible confounding factors of which the experimenter is not aware.
